sources.title: In the Weights: New Tool Lets You Check If You Exist in AI Model ...
sources.snippet: Former OpenAI employees launch 'In the Weights,' a tool that queries multiple AI models to measure how well they recall a person's existence from training data.

sources.title: AI Essentials: What are model weights? - ENGINE
sources.snippet: Model weights play a crucial role in determining the outputs of AI systems and access to model weights can enable an individual to make beneficial changes to the model (addressing a biased result or creating a new product) or to make malevolent changes (allowing the model to create CSAM or other illegal content).

sources.title: Google Chrome silently installs 4 GB Gemini Nano AI model to user ...
sources.snippet: Google Chrome is silently auto-installing a 4 GB Gemini Nano AI model file on user devices without any consent, enabling AI features by default. Users must disable AI features completely or uninstall Chrome to remove this large AI model file.
